patch_description: This version retains direct simultaneous optimization of centers and radii, analytic constraint derivatives, and final strict feasibility scaling. It improves exploration by combining the original staggered-row seed with several perturbed lattice seeds, alternating-phase hexagonal seeds, and a second polishing optimization from the best discovered packing. This gives SLSQP access to different contact graphs and boundary arrangements while remaining deterministic and comfortably within the time limit.
